## Reading in Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(reshape2)
```

## Reading in Analysis Dataset
```{r}
load("All_Condition_Data_Deltas.Rdata")
All_Condition_Data_Deltas = All_Condition_Deltas_Filtered
```

## Reading in 2024 Data for Coordinates
```{r}
Condition_Filepath = "../data/Condition/ModeledRegionHPMSFiles.gdb/"

Condition_2024_w_Geo = st_read(dsn = Condition_Filepath,
                               layer = "HPMS_ModReg_2024")
```

## Creating Coordinate Lookup Table
```{r}
Geometry_2024 = Condition_2024_w_Geo %>%
  select(route_id,begin_point,end_point,county_code,Shape) %>%
  rename(ROUTE_ID = route_id,
         BEGIN_POINT = begin_point,
         END_POINT = end_point,
         geometry = Shape)
```

## Filling In or Removing Missing Data
```{r}
Analysis_Dataset = All_Condition_Data_Deltas %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ROUTE_ID) %>%
  fill(SURFACE_TYPE,.direction="downup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(IRI_Delta)) %>%
  left_join(Geometry_2024) %>%
  filter(county_code == 1) %>%
  select(-county_code) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-YEAR_RECORD,-ROUTE_ID,-BEGIN_POINT,-END_POINT) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  mutate(NHS = if_else(NHS == 0,0,1)) %>%
  mutate(F_SYSTEM = if_else(F_SYSTEM == 1,1,0)) %>%
  mutate(SURFACE_TYPE = case_when(SURFACE_TYPE == 1~1,
                                  SURFACE_TYPE %in% c(2,6,7,8)~2,
                                  SURFACE_TYPE %in% c(3,4,5,9,10)~3,
                                  TRUE ~ 4))
```

## Mapping Sections
```{r}
All_Condition_Data_Deltas %>%
  #filter(NHS == 1 & F_SYSTEM == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ROUTE_ID) %>%
  fill(SURFACE_TYPE,.direction="downup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(IRI_Delta)) %>%
  left_join(Geometry_2024) %>%
  filter(county_code == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  select(ROUTE_ID, BEGIN_POINT, END_POINT,geometry) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_zm() %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addPolylines(weight = 2) %>%
  addProviderTiles(provider = "Esri.WorldTopoMap")

```

## Correlation Analysis
```{r}
Analysis_Dataset %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(IRI, AADT, F_SYSTEM, NHS, SURFACE_TYPE, AADT_Delta, IRI_Delta) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs",method = "pearson") %>%
  melt() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",
                      midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1,1), space = "Lab",
                      name = "Correlation") +
  ggtitle("Analysis Dataset Correlation Matrix") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  

```

## Records by Road Designation
```{r}
Analysis_Dataset %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(NHS, F_SYSTEM) %>%
  summarize(Count = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = NHS,
              values_from = Count)

```

## Records by Surface Type
```{r}
Analysis_Dataset %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(SURFACE_TYPE = case_when(
    SURFACE_TYPE == 1 ~ "Unpaved",
    SURFACE_TYPE == 2 ~ "Asphalt/Composite",
    SURFACE_TYPE == 3 ~ "Concrete",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  group_by(SURFACE_TYPE) %>%
  summarize(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = SURFACE_TYPE, y = Count), stat = "identity") +
  ylab("Record Count") +
  xlab("Surface Type") +
  ggtitle("Records by Surface Type") +
  theme_bw()
```



## Mapping All Sections
```{r}
Map_Data = All_Condition_Data_Deltas %>%
  mutate(NHS = if_else(NHS == 0,0,1)) %>%
  mutate(F_SYSTEM = if_else(F_SYSTEM == 1,1,0)) %>%
  mutate(SURFACE_TYPE = case_when(SURFACE_TYPE == 1~1,
                                  SURFACE_TYPE %in% c(2,6,7,8)~2,
                                  SURFACE_TYPE %in% c(3,4,5,9,10)~3,
                                  TRUE ~ 4)) %>%
  #filter(NHS == 1 & F_SYSTEM == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ROUTE_ID) %>%
  fill(SURFACE_TYPE,.direction="downup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(IRI_Delta)) %>%
  left_join(Geometry_2024) %>%
  filter(county_code == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  select(ROUTE_ID, BEGIN_POINT, END_POINT,F_SYSTEM,NHS,geometry) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_zm()
  

Map_Data %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addPolygons(
    color = "blue",    
    weight = 1) %>%
  addProviderTiles(provider = "Esri.WorldGrayCanvas")
```

## Map by Interstate
```{r}
pal_categorical <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("red","blue"),             
  domain = Map_Data$F_SYSTEM      
)

Map_Data %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addPolygons(fillColor = ~pal_categorical(F_SYSTEM),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = ~pal_categorical(F_SYSTEM),    
    weight = 1) %>%
  addProviderTiles(provider = "Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal_categorical, 
    values = ~F_SYSTEM, 
    title = "Interstate", 
    position = "bottomright"
  )

```

## Map by 2024 IRI
```{r}
Map_Data_IRI = All_Condition_Data_Deltas %>%
  filter(YEAR_RECORD == 2024) %>%
  mutate(NHS = if_else(NHS == 0,0,1)) %>%
  mutate(F_SYSTEM = if_else(F_SYSTEM == 1,1,0)) %>%
  mutate(SURFACE_TYPE = case_when(SURFACE_TYPE == 1~1,
                                  SURFACE_TYPE %in% c(2,6,7,8)~2,
                                  SURFACE_TYPE %in% c(3,4,5,9,10)~3,
                                  TRUE ~ 4)) %>%
  #filter(NHS == 1 & F_SYSTEM == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ROUTE_ID) %>%
  fill(SURFACE_TYPE,.direction="downup") %>%
  filter(!is.na(IRI_Delta)) %>%
  left_join(Geometry_2024) %>%
  filter(county_code == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  select(ROUTE_ID, BEGIN_POINT, END_POINT, IRI,geometry) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_zm() %>%
  mutate(IRI_Group = case_when(IRI <=90 ~ "Good",
                               IRI<= 170 ~ "Fair",
                               IRI > 170 ~ "Poor")) %>%
  arrange(IRI_Group) %>%
  mutate(IRI = if_else(IRI > 500,500,IRI))

    pal_numeric_IRI <- colorNumeric(
      palette = c("green", "yellow", "red"),             
      domain =Map_Data_IRI$IRI    
    )

Map_Data_IRI %>%
  mutate(IRI = round(IRI,1)) %>%
  mutate(info = paste0("<b>Route:</b> ",ROUTE_ID, 
                       "<br/><b>Mileposts:</b> ",BEGIN_POINT,"-",END_POINT,
                       "<br/><b>IRI:</b> ",IRI)) %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addPolylines(fillColor = ~pal_numeric_IRI(IRI),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = ~pal_numeric_IRI(IRI),    
    weight = 2,
    popup = ~info) %>%
  addProviderTiles(provider = "Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal_numeric_IRI,
    values = ~IRI,
    title = "Pavement IRI Condition",
    position = "bottomright"
  )


```

## Writing New Analysis Dataset
```{r}
save(Analysis_Dataset,file = "Analysis_Dataset.Rdata")

```
